race.title: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
race.verdict: It's fair to say I'M THE ONE hasn't lived up to expectations so far after her wide-margin debut win but she still sets the standard on her Cheshire Oaks form and testing conditions could well bring out the best in her (dam Group 1 winner in the mud). Felicitas looks the main threat back down in class, while Prosperity and Wadooda are both progressive. I'M THE ONE FELICITAS PROSPERITY
race.bettingForecast: Felicitas (5/1), Revoir (6/1), I'm The One (6/1), Ribbon Of Sea (7/1), Wadooda (8/1), Together Now (10/1), Moments Of Joy (12/1), Saga Gaga (12/1), Prosperity (14/1), Zgharta (14/1), K Sarra (16/1), Asset (16/1), Bay Colony (25/1), Seren Star (25/1), Garden Party (25/1), Mobberley Rose (33/1), Ourbren (66/1)
